dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-section toward a pointed posterior peduncle terminal visible at the bottom of the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter-grey patches distributed irregularly along the central dorsal axis and upper flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the darker primary skin tone and the lighter-grey mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast, light-grey longitudinal linear marks (likely rake marks) oriented parallel to the central axis on the left dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, well-defined longitudinal linear scar or series of rake marks located on the left side of the mid-dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular aperture representing the blowhole located on the anterior dorsal surface, surrounded by a subtle concentrated specular highlight.
